notes.title: SHRIMP GAME playtest all weekend!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]The SHRIMP GAME online playtest is open to all Steam users from May 3rd 9 AM EST to May 5th 10 PM EST![/b][/h1]
[h2]Press the "request access to the playtest" button on the Store page![/h2]
[h2]Host a game or hop in a public / a friends game and get to krilling!![/h2]
[h4]Expect bugs ;)[/h4]
